description: Normalized vulnerability scanning evidence for one system, such as AWS or GitHub. Each entry in scanners gives one scanner's coverage and its open findings by severity. A finding is overdue when it is critical and open more than 30 days, or high and open more than 90 days. When a system has several accounts, scanners holds totals across all of them, and scopes lists each account at the audit level. A *_present flag is then true when it is true in any scope. Every metric is optional. Below the audit level, counts are left out, and the *_present flags are written instead

schema_version.x-epack-summary: Output schema version this artifact was emitted at.

provider.description: The system the scanners run in, such as aws or github
provider.x-epack-summary: The system the scanners run in, such as AWS or GitHub.

scanners.description: One entry per scanner and category. In one scope, a scanner turned on per resource, such as per repository, is enabled when it is on for at least one resource, and coverage_pct gives the share it covers. When the system has scopes, the top-level enabled is true only when the scanner is enabled in every scope
scanners.x-epack-summary: One entry for each scanner and category, with its coverage and open findings. When the system has several accounts or subscriptions, a scanner counts as enabled only when it is enabled in all of them.

scopes.description: One entry per account or subscription. Each entry lists that account's scanners
scopes.x-epack-summary: One entry for each account or subscription. Each entry lists the scanners for that account or subscription alone.

scanner.description: A fixed name for the scanner, such as inspector, dependabot, code_scanning, or secret_scanning
scanner.x-epack-summary: A fixed name for the scanner, such as inspector or dependabot.

category.description: The kind of resource the entry covers. A scanner that covers several kinds has an entry for each
category.x-epack-summary: The kind of resource in this entry, such as hosts or dependencies.

enabled.description: Whether the scanner is turned on for this category. A scanner turned on per resource, such as per repository, is on when it covers at least one resource
enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether the scanner is enabled for this category.

resources_present.description: Whether there are resources the scanner could cover. When false, coverage_pct has none to count
resources_present.x-epack-summary: Whether there are any resources in this category to scan.

resource_count.x-epack-summary: Resources in this category that could be scanned.

scanned_resource_count.description: Resources counted in resource_count that the scanner covers
scanned_resource_count.x-epack-summary: Resources in this category that are scanned.

coverage_pct.description: Percentage of resources the scanner covers. Null when there are none
coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of resources in this category that are scanned.

open_critical_present.description: Whether the scanner has open critical findings
open_critical_present.x-epack-summary: Whether there are any open findings rated critical.

open_high_present.description: Whether the scanner has open high findings
open_high_present.x-epack-summary: Whether there are any open findings rated high.

overdue_present.description: Whether the scanner has overdue findings
overdue_present.x-epack-summary: Whether there are any overdue findings. A finding is overdue when it is rated critical and open more than 30 days, or rated high and open more than 90 days.

overdue_critical_count.description: Critical findings open more than 30 days
overdue_critical_count.x-epack-summary: Findings rated critical and open more than 30 days.

overdue_high_count.description: High findings open more than 90 days
overdue_high_count.x-epack-summary: Findings rated high and open more than 90 days.

kind.x-epack-summary: Whether this entry is an account or a subscription.

scanners.description: The scanners for this scope alone, with the same fields
scanners.x-epack-summary: The scanners for this account or subscription alone.
